_why: mp:MP-LANG. capture_c1_host_line.png is an IN-GAME frame: the map view differs between runs and the chat line is drawn in the SENDER's faction colour, which the game picks per match. The claim is the glyph SHAPES of the host's UTF-8 line (Cyrillic + Polish decoded on an EN client), so only the top-left text band is compared, colour-blind (ink mode). Terrain in the band is below the ink threshold (measured: 0 ink pixels past x=155). FLAKE FIX (2026-09-29): capture_c_lobby.png carries mp:L1b's lobby ping cell on the seated rows (mh/ui/lobby_ping.cpp: 'D <srtt ms>'), a live SRTT MEASUREMENT -- 'D 0' solo, 'D 1' when the box is busy (the 2/9 reds: 19 px, bbox x 351..354 y 129..135, the digit alone). Masked: the cell's whole column on the two seated rows ([322,106,44,36], mp_client_el2's rect) -- the text is laid out by width, so 'D 224' starts 12 px left of 'D 0' and the 'D' moves with the digits (a digits-only mask went red the first time a baseline held a 3-digit value). mp:U50 (2026-10-02): the ping became its own widget right of the flag; the ping-cell rects moved left to x=313 with their right edge unchanged.
